test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question:
Which of the following correctly completes the given statement?

Index number helps in:

(I) determining the cost of living

(II) fixing the dearness allowances

(III) reflecting the real income
solution:
The correct answer is **All I, II and III.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Index numbers** are statistical measures that calculate changes in a set of values over time.
 
• **Index numbers** are commonly used in economics to measure changes in the cost of living and to track changes in real income.
 
• **Index numbers** are not primarily used to fix dearness allowances, but they can assist in the process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Index numbers are calculated relative to a base period and are used to determine the rate of inflation.
 
• The information obtained from index numbers is important in determining the impact of inflation on an economy and the purchasing power of consumers.
 
• There are several types of index numbers, including the **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** and the **Producer Price Index (PPI)**, which measure changes in the prices of goods and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Index numbers provide valuable information about changes in the **cost of living and real income**, which is crucial for policy makers and economists.
 
• Understanding the concept and calculation of index numbers is important for those studying economics and finance.
 
• The accuracy of index numbers is important, as they are used to make decisions that can impact the economy and people's lives.
